findings.description: Selected initialization could fail before leaving an enrollment signal. Pending marker and generic configured-init failure handling now preserve blocking state; independent missing-baseline case passed.

The new checkpoint receipt callback required a completion seal after partial submission. It now skips noncompleted reports; real partial submission/checkpoint succeeds and publication remains rejected.

limitations: Cooperating local CLI controls only. Same-user rewriting of enrollment, evidence or checkpoint receipts, old CLI and direct Git remain outside the boundary.

Environment fingerprint covers local executable/configuration/distribution metadata, not every base interpreter or package implementation byte.
